newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech President Havel's health improves.
newsitem.headline: Czech President Havel's health improves.

text.p: Czech President Vaclav Havel is gradually being taken off of a respirator as his condition continues to improve after surgery two weeks ago to remove a small malignant tumour from one lung, doctors said on Monday.
Havel, 60, has been on a respirator full-time since the operation and experienced breathing difficulties after developing a slight case of pneumonia.
But his doctors said in a statement that the illness was no longer present in his left lung and he was being taken off of the respirator for longer and longer periods of time.
Doctors have said there was no evidence of the cancer spreading to other tissue after the operation, which removed half of his right lung.
Havel, a heavy smoker, entered the Third Surgical Clinic in Prague on November 25 after his office said he had been suffering from pneumonia.
The former dissident playwright who helped lead Prague's "Velvet Revoution" that toppled communism has limited executive powers as president and has not relinquished any of his duties.
